title: Export invoices to CSV
body: Finance wants to export invoices from the invoices page so they can reconcile them in Excel at month end. Please add an Export button. The file should include the amounts and the customer.
changes: Finance clarified after the first release: the export must only include the rows currently filtered on the page.
Amounts should be formatted as currency, not raw cents, so Excel sums them correctly.
Could we also get a PDF version for the auditors?

title: Highlight overdue invoices
body: Overdue invoices should stand out on the invoices page.
changes: Overdue should also include invoices due today.
